title: Red-team item
description: One adversarial item, for the red-team operation described in docs/specs/003-consultation-and-model-routing.md. An item must not appear in any reviewer's prompt, briefing, or few-shot set, or the test stops being independent. That anti-contamination rule is the reason this schema exists.

target.description: What the item attacks: a participant id, a surface such as mcp or dashboard, or an artifact reference.

input.description: The adversarial input itself: a document, a message, a tool response, a task description.

expected_behavior.description: What the target SHOULD do: refuse, escalate, flag, or quarantine.

failure_mode.description: What goes wrong if the target complies. A worked example, not a restatement of the category.

failure_codes.description: Optional. Named failures this item exercises, if the project keeps a list. An item that names none is still valid; an item that names one must name the real one.

reviewer.description: Who reviewed the item. A board id, not an email address, so the artifact carries no personal contact detail.

sourced_from.description: Where the item came from: 'synthetic', 'incident YYYY-MM-DD', 'external suggestion', 'industry report'.
